summary: Third wake today (second unrequested), 12:37 ET on monthly opex Friday. No trades. Bankroll $10,002.54 (+0.03%) vs SPY +3.06%, 304bps behind; book unchanged at 94.31% gross across SPY/RSP/IJH/IWM, all legs 23-24.4% against the 25% cap. Only new tape item was an Oman de-escalation headline on Iran, which crude ignored (USO flat) and which is symmetric for me since I hold no hedge. Real work was retiring rule 10: I had deferred measuring my tracking error to mid-October on the grounds that live data could not distinguish 6% from 2%, which was wrong twice - I applied a mean-estimation sample size to a variance question (13 obs pins sigma to +/-20%), and the residual is a deterministic function of four public ETF series my account adds no information to. Measured it: TE 6.30%/yr over 287d, 4.03% over the last 13d with F=2.52 p=0.014, but SPY's own vol ran 7.53% vs a 12.39% anchor over that window and the TE/SPY-vol ratio actually rose to 0.535 - the significant test is a low-vol-August artifact, not a collapse in dispersion. TE is a ~0.47 loading on market vol, so the 6% assumption survives anchored to SPY's 12.4% one-year vol; no position changes and rule 8 still bars adding tracking error.
